title: SharpCompress
description: Stream and compress archive files in .NET with support for ZIP, RAR, TAR, GZIP, and 7z.

data.text: `SharpCompress` is a streaming archive library that reads and writes `ZIP`, `RAR`, `TAR`, `GZIP`, `BZIP2`, `XZ`, and `7z` files. It is fully managed and well-suited for both small scripts and large-scale file processing.
Use `ArchiveFactory.Open` to detect the archive type and iterate entries.

data.title: List Archive Contents
data.content: Read and list entries in a ZIP file.

data.text: Use `ArchiveFactory.Create` to build a new archive from files.

data.title: Create a ZIP Archive
data.content: Compress files into a ZIP archive.

terms.definition: Opens and creates archives while auto-detecting the format.
Represents a single entry inside an archive.
Specifies the compression algorithm, such as Deflate or BZip2.

data.title: Tip
data.text: SharpCompress streams entries, so it uses constant memory regardless of archive size. This makes it safe for server applications.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: SharpCompress supports ZIP, RAR, TAR, GZIP, 7z, and more
Streaming API keeps memory usage low
Fully managed with no native dependencies
data.takeaway: SharpCompress is the standard choice for archive operations in .NET.
